ExecutionPacket.purpose: Add or migrate one approved StudentTaskCard without source-contract, collection, graph, verification, or editor-evidence drift.
ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Only an AcceptedTaskCard from M-TASK-VALIDATION may enter M-TASK-LIBRARY. A StudentTaskCard uses the ordinary or complex mode, one fixed editor profile, complete copy-ready starter code, exactly three hints, closed solution, self-check and five-field metadata. A changed card synchronizes exactly one thematic collection, zero or one interview, graph, verification and Beads evidence.
ExecutionPacket.graph-entry-excerpt: M-TASK-LIBRARY accepts output from M-TASK-VALIDATION, conforms to M-TASK-TEMPLATE, is governed by M-GOVERNANCE, and is projected into M-CATALOG.

dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-1: Authoring, synchronization, stop-condition, and Beads evidence rules.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-2: Two card modes, five metadata labels, editor profiles, copy-ready and FILE rules, exact hints, navigation, and progressive disclosure.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-3: Strict candidate or migration decisions, preservation ledger, target-editor verdict, collection sync, and rendered evidence.

ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: Run V-M-TASK-VALIDATION, V-M-TASK-LIBRARY, V-M-CATALOG, and V-M-GOVERNANCE. Verify mode, editor profile, CardMigrationEvidence, complete copy-ready code, exact hints, target-editor expected/actual/verdict, local and supplementary links, exactly one thematic and zero-or-one interview membership, graph and verification sync, pushed commit, GitHub-rendered evidence, complete report, and technical publication status.

assumptions.assumption-1: The task has an accepted validation decision with task-appropriate evidence.
assumptions.assumption-2: The stable task slug, source learning goal, source prerequisite, source runtime assumption, selected mode, editor profile, five metadata fields, collection membership, assets, and supplementary links can be resolved before editing.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop when three useful hints are unavailable; code is not copy-runnable; a file is undescribed; technology, editor, or profile is ambiguous; multiple files are unnecessary; FILE paths mismatch; an embedded asset replacement fails; metadata and collections drift; membership duplicates; a required link fails; GitHub renders unexpectedly; mandatory evidence is unavailable; or permanent tooling would be required.

notes.note-1: Workers should only read more context when the packet is insufficient.

CandidateValidationRecord.learning-goal: Independently authored one-sentence observable learning goal.
CandidateValidationRecord.decision-reason: Concise contract, quality, or duplication reason.
CandidateValidationRecord.wave-id: Wave child issue ID for accepted, otherwise none

CardMigrationEvidence.editor-profile: Programiz | CodePen | TypeScript Playground | React TypeScript
CardMigrationEvidence.source-runtime-assumption: Exact source runtime, browser, classic or ESM, language, and framework assumption.

preservation-ledger.learning-goal-destination: Visible condition, code comments, readiness criteria, hints, solution explanation, or self-check.
preservation-ledger.prerequisite-destination: Visible condition or first place of use; concrete not-applicable rationale only when it never affected attempt, solution, or verification.
preservation-ledger.runtime-assumption-destination: Editor instruction or adjacent code context; concrete not-applicable rationale only when behavior is unaffected.

CardMigrationEvidence.destination-locations: Exact card headings, comments, metadata, collection entries, graph, and verification references.
CardMigrationEvidence.target-editor-instruction: Exact copy/run steps performed by the student.
CardMigrationEvidence.target-editor-expected: Observable expected output, interaction, type result, or visual state.
CardMigrationEvidence.target-editor-actual: Observed target-editor output, interaction, type result, or visual state.

collection-sync.thematic-collection: Exactly one path and matching linked title, sentence, and duration.
collection-sync.interview-collection: Zero or one path and matching linked title and duration.
collection-sync.graph-verification-beads: Matching graph annotation, verification fact, and Beads evidence.

StudentHubCutoverEvidence.root-blocks: Exactly Как пользоваться базой, Подборки по направлениям, Симуляции собеседований, and Где писать код.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.root-negative-checks: No old task table, metadata-source explanation, or agent-maintenance prose.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.collection-inventory: Exactly ten thematic and three interview README paths, all linked from the root hub.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.thematic-membership: Twenty unique task links; every task belongs to exactly one thematic collection.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.interview-membership: Fifteen unique task links; no task belongs to two interviews.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.editor-map: All four root URLs agree with the twenty fixed card profiles.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.graph-verification-sync: Every task export annotation names one thematic and zero-or-one interview collection; Phase 14 and Gate-Phase-14 are implemented.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.phase-15-state: pending until the published GitHub-rendered audit passes.

notes.note-1: Only list graph facts that really changed in repository artifacts.

module-checks.command-1: Verify accepted validation status or migration PASS, selected mode, five metadata labels, controlled values, editor profile, exact hints, navigation, and mandatory document anchors.
module-checks.command-2: Verify one complete copy-ready block or justified real files with matching FILE paths; resolve navigation, prerequisite, media asset, collection, and supplementary links.
module-checks.command-3: Verify preservation ledger and final target-editor expected, actual, and verdict plus applicable browser or manual visual evidence.
module-checks.command-4: Prove that the task slug appears in exactly one thematic collection, zero or one interview, one graph annotation, and matching verification and Beads facts.

required-evidence-anchors.marker-2: Условие / Код — вставьте его в редактор / Готово, когда / three exact hints / Решение / Самопроверка
required-evidence-anchors.marker-4: thematic, optional interview, graph, verification, and Beads sync

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: A task change must not complete before target-editor evidence and collection, graph, verification, and Beads synchronization are verified.

wave-follow-up.item-1: Compare card title, duration, editor profile, mode, thematic and optional interview entries, graph annotation, verification fact, and Beads evidence.

phase-follow-up.item-1: Run the full candidate and migration status, collection membership, vocabulary, XML, link, editor evidence, technical-publication, and GitHub-rendering review; prepare the complete library for final user acceptance.

FailurePacket.scenario: A migrated card, its target-editor evidence, and student collections disagree.
FailurePacket.preservation-ledger: Source learning goal, prerequisite, runtime assumption, and destination status.
FailurePacket.collection-sync: Expected thematic, optional interview, graph, verification, and Beads facts.

expected-evidence.marker-1: One complete StudentTaskCard, one thematic CollectionEntry, zero or one interview entry, and matching graph and verification facts.
expected-evidence.assertion-1: The task slug, student title, duration, editor profile, preserved source facts, and target-editor result must match exactly.

observed-evidence.artifact-1: The card or evidence record contains one fact.
observed-evidence.artifact-2: A collection, graph, verification, editor result, or Beads record contains a different fact or is missing.

FailurePacket.first-divergent-block: First card, editor, collection, graph, verification, or Beads fact that diverges.
FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Preserve the source learning contract, repair the first divergent fact, and rerun target-editor plus full synchronization checks without claiming PASS while evidence is unavailable.

evidence-captured.item-1: Card mode, editor profile, preservation ledger, target-editor expected/actual/verdict, thematic and optional interview entries, graph, verification, links, and Beads status agree.

CheckpointReport.editor-profile: Programiz | CodePen | TypeScript Playground | React TypeScript
CheckpointReport.collection-sync: Exactly one thematic, zero-or-one interview, graph, verification, and Beads facts synchronized.
